purpose: Adversarially audit only the frozen validated Codex result, waiver-aware comparison and synthesis plan without acquiring new research facts.
post_audit_holds: Claude and Grok absence remains visible and confidence remains medium.
WM-ACT-036 containment remains candidate and grants no cascade authority.
Research type, subject kind, jurisdiction, ethics, consent, safety, privacy and records profiles remain mandatory before deployment.
FHIR, CDISC, WHO and ClinicalTrials.gov mappings remain version-pinned and loss-declaring.
ISO and access-restricted CDISC claims remain limited to inspected public metadata.
audit_findings: The aggregate boundary is coherent: it owns one subject-to-study participation and typed assertions while external masters retain their own lifecycles.
The structure prevents screening, eligibility, consent, enrolment, allocation, exposure, adherence and completion from collapsing into one status.
Withdrawal scopes and post-exit data or specimen handling are explicit and do not imply automatic deletion or universal retention.
Autonomous recruitment, eligibility, consent, intervention, unblinding, re-identification, safety, compensation and disclosure are explicitly prohibited.
No unresolved critical semantic conflict prevents reviewable-draft publication.
